what: Version 1 is frozen: the judging rule in the README is not met
why: Judged on 2026-11-13 in the owner's time zone (2026-11-12 in UTC, which this log's timestamps use), eleven days before the date the README set (2026-11-24), on the owner's instruction. ./pb stats shows 23 use events: 10 helped (43%), 11 partly, 2 no, none confirmed by the owner. The first condition is met (at least ten uses). The second is not: two in three helped needs 16 of 23. Reaching it by 2026-11-24 would take 16 further uses all marked helped; the 31 days so far produced 23 uses. Partly was not rescored and the bar was not moved. Also on record: 113 searches on the owner's machine, 50 of them returned nothing, 29 misses logged, 5 of 13 entries never used.

what: Version 2 starts: used entries installed as skills, one retirement, one rewrite; judged on 2026-12-25 on confirmed uses
why: The owner decided on 2026-11-13 (owner's time zone), after version 1 was frozen, to run one more version with three changes and nothing else. Retrieval: the entries that were used, and search-that-proves-it-ran, are linked into the harness's skill folder so that the harness offers them by description; review-web-animations is left out because the pack skill it was adapted from is already installed there; ./pb find stays as the fallback. Content: verify-agent-output is retired under the existing rule (three uses, none helped); no entry is retired for lack of use and no new entry is written yet, so that misses can build up. Rewrite: drive-web-app-in-headless-chrome, from the notes on its uses. The test, set before any of this was built: on 2026-12-25, six weeks after the build, only uses logged after this event that the owner has confirmed are counted. Fewer than ten confirmed uses, or fewer than two in three of them confirmed as helped, and the library is frozen for good with no version 3. Partly is not helped. This overrides the consequence of the version 1 rule (no further work); the version 1 verdict stands.

The confirm event lets the owner give the verdict on a use after it was logged, which the version 2 test counts. The rule that lack of use alone never retires an entry is unchanged.
